title: Sheesha
cliffhanger: Sheeshe mein kamra khali hai. Uske peechhe koi nahi hai.

shots.narration_hinglish: Papa ne kaha — sheesha pehli raat khol mat.
shots.caption_devanagari: पापा ने कहा — शीशा पहली रात मत खोलना।
shots.visual_prompt: first person POV, long dark corridor of an old North Indian haveli at 2am, single warm lamp far at the end, drifting fog, no people, cinematic horror, shallow depth
first person POV in a pitch dark room at night, a single small phone screen glowing cold blue on a bed sheet, everything else black, cinematic horror

shots.narration_hinglish: Raat ko sheesha dhak se band tha, phir bhi andar koi hil raha tha.
shots.caption_devanagari: रात को शीशा ढक से बंद था, फिर भी अंदर कोई हिल रहा था।
shots.visual_prompt: first person POV down a narrow old stairwell at night, worn stone steps, iron railing, pale moonlight from a window, fog, no people, cinematic horror
first person POV of a tall old framed mirror in a dark hall, an old sari cloth being pulled off it, dim lamp light, heavy fog, cinematic horror

shots.narration_hinglish: Sheeshe mein kamra, kursi, deewar — aur kamra khali.
shots.caption_devanagari: शीशे में कमरा, कुर्सी, दीवार — और कमरा खाली।
shots.visual_prompt: first person POV looking into an empty old mirror at night, the reflected room holds a chair and a wall but no person, dim amber light, cinematic horror
shots.negative_extra: reflection of a person, figure, face

shots.narration_hinglish: Mera chehra nahi tha, uske peechhe koi nahi tha.
shots.caption_devanagari: मेरा चेहरा नहीं था, उसके पीछे कोई नहीं था।
shots.visual_prompt: first person POV of a dark doorway backlit from behind, a tall faceless female silhouette standing in the frame with a draped cloth, fog, cinematic horror
first person POV holding still on an empty mirror at night, faint fog, nothing moving, cinematic horror
